Packing props match the exact pre-lift state: four mango pits, tiny sunglasses, rolled cricket-player poster, intact puri on napkin, open luggage with kite/diya, and separate terracotta bowl on blue blanket. The competing guarded possessions and sideways expressions carry the joke.

Torso silhouettes are smooth and restrained; faint underlying wash texture does not create raised shag volume. Buddy ear, muzzle and brow furnishings are regionally appropriate. Tail is slender with modest fringe. No material visual finding.

Anatomy and support are coherent: both dogs have four owned feet with floor contact, Neet retains full narrow torso and nub, and Buddy has substantial legs, neck and a continuous elongated trunk. Humans hand and elbow ownership are readable.

The crumbled puri dust, caught napkin, open tote and officer sneeze match the anchor; Buddy protects the bundled blanket beside Heather. Heather-only household is preserved and the generic terminal adds no chronology repair. Two independent reactions make the scene useful.

Material finish fault: Buddy shoulder, upper foreleg and broad torso are densely filled with discrete fur-shaped raised strokes, and the withers/back outline has lifted hair tips. This reads as a rough all-over coat rather than the close dark torso in B04/B29; it is distinct from broad environmental watercolor paper grain. Smooth these body regions and contour while retaining regional brows, moustache, ear and foot furnishings. Reinspect entire replacement.

Neet sits with connected folded haunch, separate fine forelegs and upright broad ears; the nub is hidden by the seat angle rather than replaced by a long tail. Buddy has continuous neck-to-trunk connection and separate limbs, with forefeet supported on blanket and hindfeet on pavement. His modest tapered tail fringe is within photographic variability and is not itself a defect.

Buddy looks down toward the empty terracotta bowl after the sniff; a sealed spice packet stays on pavement. Heather and luggage remain behind the dogs in a credible arrivals curb scene. This is a distinct quiet temptation payoff and fits both primary and lounge-omission abridgement.

Material finish fault: raised tufts along Buddy nape/withers and upper shoulder, and broad fur-shaped strokes on the short charcoal torso, carry rough coat volume beyond the documented regional furnishing. Retain the face/ear furnishings and modest tail fringe, but smooth nape-to-body contour and torso coat to a restrained close wash. Reinspect the entire replacement.
